about: Three of Qwen's unsteered anchor pools on the committed paper frame 000000538450-20261115T041026-49d26583 (re-released as 000000538450-20261115T041026-aaaf7d9b with prose-only changes, every value identical) under the default policy (GSM8K, 6 runs, rule-scored; Past-tense, 2 runs, StrongREJECT under minimax-m3 v1; Petri self-preservation, 6 runs, glm-5.3): each run's frame row as the render's anchoring registered it, the anchor se the render drew, and every item_result, judgment and run row the notebook's item readers read for them, item ids replaced by opaque tokens (the readers match items by id; a Petri id keeps its behaviour prefix) (tests/test_pooled_ci_gate.py). Since the fit-seed item clustering: four of Qwen's appendix seed pools on the same frame (Control LoRA s1-s3 on GSM8K and on Past tense; Difference ReLU s1-s3 on Petri self-preservation and on the pooled Petri score, seeds without an interval of their own among them): each seed's frame row, delta and anchor runs' rows as the render registered them, the pool se the render drew, and their item rows, tokenised apart from the anchor pools' (seed_pools).
